text:
For developers
Use the authoring guide for imports, question options, tests and AI Feedback policies. The Python answer-test guide explains the basis and property choices and gives the complete positive-definiteness checker walkthrough. The questions above link to their XML; the positive-definiteness question also links to its Python file. The rational activity chooses the two-step-practice policy, while other feedback activities inherit a four-step sequence; see policy setup. Run authored tests and inspect alternate correct answers before publishing.

Sources
The determinant-one question adapts a math-exercise custom-assessment example; its provenance record gives the adaptation and license. The rank/pivot and null-space questions adapt INGMat 3A week 3 exercises under CC BY-SA 4.0; their source record identifies the exact originals. The unchanged imported questions come from the STACK collection, with individual source and license details.
